plugins.changelog: Fixes Jellyfin 12.4 startup failing with 'Library Bridge is not initialized'. Creates the recovery journal from early server application paths, preserves the existing journal directory, and adds early-startup persistence regression tests.
Initial catalog release: native scheduled synchronization of parental certifications and Parents Guide tags, with configurable dry runs and incremental state.

Translates the PostgreSQL dashboard, confirmation dialogs, errors, logs, health reports, migration output and documentation into English. Retains Jellyfin 12.4 compatibility, query-performance fixes, existing configuration and database state.
